create_SymbolicBounds: create SymbolicBounds to compute Fast-Lin symbolic lower and upper bounds for neural network layers
build_SymbolicBounds_apply_linear: build linear layer bounds using SymbolicBounds.apply_linear with weight matrix and bias
build_SymbolicBounds_apply_conv1d: build 1D convolution layer bounds using SymbolicBounds.apply_conv1d with weights, padding, and stride
build_SymbolicBounds_apply_conv2d: build 2D convolution layer bounds using SymbolicBounds.apply_conv2d with weights, padding, and strides
run_SymbolicBounds_concretize: run SymbolicBounds.concretize to convert symbolic linear expressions into concrete interval bounds
